SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO FROM ZKEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'LTCO' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , ADD_DATE , RD_DATE , DELY_TO_LOCATION , LEGACY_PR_NO , PURCHASER_USER_ID , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REMARK FROM ZKEP_PO WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT,LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE ZKEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , IF_TINME = REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108),':','') WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
